scope: previously inspected E2b scene; descriptive policy validation, not fresh test

specification.experiment: E3 frozen-pool admission decisions, CPU adaptation
specification.evaluation_status: previously inspected E2b scene; descriptive policy validation, not fresh test
specification.pool: original-active self-branch candidates only; same frozen poses and Gaussian parameters; no refiner
specification.thresholds: reuse E2b office0-only active 99% finite-normal cumulative-max thresholds; strict greater; no room0 tuning
specification.P1: repeated relative plane conflict plus support veto, at birth only; missing BYPASS; no later review
specification.P2_bypass: same geometric test at each actual KF; missing evidence immediately BYPASS; admitted candidates remain reviewable
specification.P2: DEFER until simultaneous >=2 reliable plane observations; reject if sealed repeated conflict exceeds threshold; otherwise KEEP including explicit support veto; after 2 subsequent KFs unresolved BYPASS; review admitted candidates; rejection absorbing
specification.P2_unbounded: same as P2 without timeout; unresolved end-of-stream stays DEFER and absent from rendering
specification.P3: P2 plus AND confirmation by finite B7 NCC exceeding its own development threshold; missing RGB at geometric conflict DEFER until timeout; no RGB retuning
specification.baseline_semantics: B2 and B8 decide once at birth; B6/B7 recheck all nonrejected candidates at actual KF arrivals; missing evidence BYPASS; B8 renders its own strictly older admitted map
specification.end_of_stream: no force flush or synthetic future KF; queued candidates stay absent
specification.gt: evaluation-only stored E2b creation labels primary, final/GT-anchor/consensus sensitivity; no GT inside decision engine
specification.render: CPU port of local upstream forward equations for all policies; 512x288; anisotropic covariance; original DC RGB; black background; expected depth; no model training
specification.geometry: evaluate final frozen pose revision at held-out odd frames; global trajectory Sim3 evaluation only; no TSDF/E4 or system/GPU performance claim
specification.temporal_render: after each snapshot use next odd original frame (2*input_frame+1) to measure DEFER gaps; trajectory alignment stays evaluation-only
